scope: Deterministic visual tracers and chamber confinement, not CFD, molecular dynamics or cylinder thermodynamics

checks.name: All tracer centers remain inside four moving chambers over a full turn
Rod-side particles never intersect the piston rod
All particle coordinates, sizes and opacities remain finite
Minimum chamber height respects the original clearance
Identical angle and time reproduce the same cloud
A paused clock freezes every particle
Admission travels away from the upper head
Exhaust reverses towards the same upper head
A cold simulation can clear all cloud opacity
Default quality uses a bounded 384-puff budget
